receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250 billion in Microsoft Azure cloud services. However, in a significant concession in return for that certainty, Microsoft will no longer have a “right of first refusal” on new OpenAI cloud workloads.

evidence_items.explanation: Points both ways. Microsoft loosened its hold on OpenAI's compute, but OpenAI committed to far more Azure spending. 'Disconnecting' cannot be clearly scored either way.

receipt.public_excerpt: Backlog $25.9bn at 31 March 2025, being RPO of $14.7bn plus $11.2bn of other committed amounts. Names a strategic agreement with OpenAI adding $11.2bn of backlog

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's contract was a large share of CoreWeave's backlog in March 2025. The filings as summarized do not say how much of the remaining $14.7bn was Microsoft's, so 'largest customer on paper' cannot be confirmed.

unresolved_gaps: No filing I found ranks CoreWeave customers by contracted value as of March 2025.
'Disconnecting' has no measure; the later evidence points both ways.
